name: Kugayama Shiori no Shinizama Techou
source:
Even in death, Kugayama Shiori takes her own life.

Maybe her next will finally be her last.

But no matter how many times she dies, her soul refuses to leave this world.

Maybe the answer lies in her lost memories.

Maybe there's a lingering attachment she's forgotten.

Other than her name, she remembers nothing.

Who was she?

Why did she die?

Together with you—the only living person who can still speak to her—

Shiori begins her search for her memories, and for the truth behind her death.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4141950/Kugayama_Shioris_Death_Diary/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
即使死了，久我山诗织也结束了自己的生命。

也许她的下一个最终将是她的最后一个。

但无论她死多少次，她的灵魂都不愿离开这个世界。

也许答案就在她失去的记忆中。

或许，还有一段挥之不去的执念，被她遗忘了。

除了她的名字，她什么都不记得了。

她是谁？

她为什么死？

和你——唯一还能和她说话的活着的人一起——

诗织开始寻找她的记忆，以及她死亡背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4141950/Kugayama_Shioris_Death_Diary/]Steam[/url]]
